snippet.description:
Differential Calculus: Multiple Points, Double Points, Node, Cusp, and Conjugate Points explained with formulas, classification, and solved problems for B.Sc / B.Tech engineering mathematics.

Hello Learners, Fractal Frontier Maths me aapka swagat hai!

Is lecture me hum Differential Calculus ke ek bohot important topic Multiple Points (बहुल बिंदु) aur Double Points ko detail me samjhenge. Hum dekhenge ki jab kisi curve ke single point se multiple branches pass hoti hain, toh unka mathematical behavior kaisa hota hai.

📌 Is video me hum cover karenge:

✅ Multiple Points kya hote hain? (Definition & Geometry)
✅ Double Points ka classification: Node, Cusp, aur Conjugate (Isolated) Points me antar
✅ Nature of Tangents se points ka classification kaise karein
✅ Equations aur step-by-step solved examples

Timestamps
00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Curve Behavior
02:05 - Definition of Multiple Points
05:04 - Classification of Multiple Points (Double, Triple & r-th Order)
08:08 - Types of Double Points: Node, Cusp & Conjugate Points
08:34 - Definition & Nature of a Node
10:33 - Definition & Nature of a Cusp
12:43 - Definition of Conjugate (Isolated) Point
15:38 - Necessary Conditions for Existence of Double Points
18:22 - Analytical Classification using Partial Derivatives ($s^2 - rt$)
22:00 - Important Special Case: When $r = s = t = 0$
23:07 - Summary & Geometric Interpretation of Double Points
26:12 - Tangents at Origin for Algebraic Curves
27:53 - Example 1: Finding Position and Nature of Double Points
36:50 - Example 2: Proof for Node or Conjugate Point at Origin
46:00 - Summary & Preview of Next Lecture (Classification of Cusps)

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Concavity, Convexity & Point of Inflexion: Concepts & Solved Examples   → https://youtu.be/e19W3iIM4Yw

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨

#MultiplePoints #Calculus #DifferentialCalculus #BScMaths #EngineeringMathematics #CurveTracing
